fields.summary_ko.0: Walmart (WMT) posted weak Q2 U.S. comparable store sales of +2.6%, but total revenue +5.9% and operating income +29%, with stock adjusting amid high inflation concerns (P/E around 45x overvalued).
fields.summary_ko.1: Q3 results due November 19, but based on historical Q4 patterns showing continued gains after strong results and rebounds after setbacks, urgency of pre-earnings buying is low.
